lines.text: God tells Moses to bring Aaron and his four sons to serve as priests, with holy garments made by skilled craftsmen.
Two onyx stones engraved with the sons of Israel's names in birth order are fastened on the ephod's shoulder pieces.
The breastpiece is square, with four rows of three gemstones, each engraved with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
Aaron carries the names of the sons of Israel and the Urim and Thummim on his forehead before the LORD.
The robe's lower hem has pomegranates alternating with silver bells, so Aaron's sound is heard when he enters the sanctuary.
